args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The import labels the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs sorting before anyone reimports so it doesn't create duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. At 10:50 Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita (maybe)*: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an "8am check-in w the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. That suggests Wichita is a Marrow store, but the message never actually says so. Worth confirming before the call.

Not Marrow: the Tulsa hub (Tansley Parcel) and Door 6 (Tansleigh Packaging, #88412) came up in the same thread, but they're other accounts.

The 9 Jun escalation also mentioned three rows on the customer's rollout tracker that just said "waiting," with no store names. None of those stores are named anywhere in the channel, so there may be more sites than this.
